description: This file contains unit tests for the Ollama provider models, testing functions such as resolveOllamaApiBase and enrichOllamaModelsWithContext. It uses the Vitest testing framework and mocks HTTP fetch responses.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Performs cleanup after each test to unstub all global mocks.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for 'ollama provider models'.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value matches the expected condition.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for specific behaviors.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates a mock function for testing.

methods.name: vi.stubGlobal
methods.description: Overrides global functions such as fetch with mock implementations.

ctags.name: body
ctags.pattern: /^      const body = JSON.parse(requestBodyText(init?.body)) as { name?: string };$/

ctags.name: fetchMock
ctags.pattern: /^    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {$/
